block.title: square grid sheet, garrison set
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art sprite sheet on a flat deep-navy background, square layout, bold dark navy outlines, saturated limited palette, dithered metal shading, no scene, no text, no labels, no UI. A tidy grid: left column holds the SENTINEL WALKER in three cells — full profile facing left on idle stance with eye-light off, walking stance with the red eye-lamp on, and a firing pose where both shoulder cannons kick back with tiny amber muzzle flares; center column stacked with GYRE ring-gun states — the bare ring with four dark muzzles, one-muzzle-flash frame, two-muzzle alternating flash, and the ring shown with its center hub exposed for a damaged phase, small gold sparks at one broken spoke; right column holds the TRENCH EEL broken into two parts for segmented animation — a snout-and-head sprite, then a single reusable ring-plate body segment shown at three rotations, then the tail tip — plus one deck-hatch sprite, an open rectangle of grating with violet glow seeping up its edges. Pixel-perfect spacing, everything inside its cell, amber top-light consistent, no dropped outlines.
